apps.localizedDescription: Open Screen Sharing，开源 Apple VNC（macOS 屏幕共享）客户端与服务器。针对局域网与公网（Tailscale P2P）优化，并支持 RDP。侧载 IPA 含 App Store 版未提供的 iOS 端 Apple VNC 服务器与从远程 Mac 拖文件。

versions.localizedDescription:
* Add a tab bar for multiple sessions on iPad
* Extend full-screen sessions around the MacBook notch
* Add native touch input for touch displays on macOS
* Automatically take over busy High Performance sessions from other Open Screen Sharing clients
* Add RSA-AES and VeNCrypt authentication for VNC servers (RealVNC, TigerVNC, wayvnc)
* Add option to reverse scroll direction for standard VNC and RDP
* Fixes and improvements
